{"consolidated_memory":"## Lock Timeout in storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql — Two Incidents

**File affected:** storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql (storage side)

**Common issue:** Lock wait tripping statement timeout in migration 0042. Repro for both: run the migration against a loaded table.

---

### OCCASION 1: [2026-01-30]
**Trigger:** Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy only  
**Root cause:** Schema drift between the migration and the model  
**Fix:** Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum  
**PR/Branch:** PR #1714 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1  
**Outcome:** Memory settled at 122 MB instead of climbing past 4 GB

### OCCASION 2: [2026-08-01]
**Trigger:** Appeared only after the client had already retried once  
**Root cause:** A naive datetime compared against an aware one  
**Fix:** Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge  
**PR/Branch:** PR #4515 on branch fix/lock-timeout-2  
**Outcome:** The job finished in 14 minutes instead of 9 hours

---

**Note:** Both occasions affected the same migration file but required different remedies due to distinct root causes."}
